chrome-devtools.description: Repository-local DIAGNOSTIC only. Official Google Chrome DevTools MCP (ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp, Apache-2.0). Runtime profiling, IndexedDB inspection, memory/resource lifetime and complex browser-state inspection of a LOCAL Chrome/Chromium. Diagnostic authority only; no repository write/commit authority. Local/preview scope only.

context7.description: Repository-local DOCS only. Official Upstash Context7 MCP (upstash/context7, MIT). Version-aware Three.js/TypeScript/Vite documentation and code examples. Read-only; no repository write authority. Optional CONTEXT7_API_KEY may be supplied via the environment for higher rate limits (never committed).
